command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go-eye-prelive-final.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch chatgpt-work/avatar-eye-identity-canonical-mask-20260912 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git "$TMP/repo"
DIR="$TMP/repo/research_entity/avatar_eye_identity"
HEAD=$(git -C "$TMP/repo" rev-parse HEAD); echo BRANCH_HEAD=$HEAD
python3 "$DIR/test_promote_semantic_shadow_quiesced.py"
python3 -m py_compile "$DIR/promote_semantic_shadow_quiesced.py" "$DIR/validate_shadow_blink_runtime_v2.py"
SHADOW="$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_semantic_shadow5/buehne.shadow.html"
OUT="$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_shadow_runtime_v2_20260912_0916"
test -f "$SHADOW"; test ! -e "$OUT"
BEFORE=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
python3 "$DIR/validate_shadow_blink_runtime_v2.py" --visual-root "$ROOT" --shadow "$SHADOW" --out "$OUT" --http-port 9278 --cdp-port 9279 | tee "$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_shadow_runtime_v2_20260912_0916.stdout.json"
AFTER=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER"
cat "$OUT/report.json"
echo LIVE_SHA=$AFTER
echo SCOPE=REAL_BROWSER_EXACT_SHADOW_BLINK_RUNTIME_V2_PLUS_PROMOTER_REGRESSION_NO_LIVE_WRITE
